exampleEn: Trust and communication go hand in hand in a successful relationship.
exampleKo: 신뢰와 소통은 성공적인 관계에서 밀접하게 관련되어 있다.
gameExamples: Education and economic development go hand in hand in improving a country's future.
Creativity and innovation often go hand in hand in the world of technology.
Physical fitness and mental well-being go hand in hand for a healthier lifestyle.
